candidates.title: Rokid Lumen releases beta.19–.21 with cross-app handwriting, notification replies and memory fixes
candidates.summary: On October 10, the open-source Rokid Lumen project published three beta prereleases (0.2.0-beta.19, .20 and .21). The developer documents a glasses-wide input method supporting Meta Neural Band handwriting, dictation or companion-phone typing; photo-bearing notifications and custom text replies; band gesture switching; and an always-visible time/battery status bar. Beta.21 also fixes black-blinking web pages caused by overaggressive Gecko memory release. These are developer-published code/release claims and project-supplied hardware evidence, not independently reproduced GlassesResearch tests. The Neural Band link remains unofficial reverse engineering with firmware and security/installation risks documented in the earlier October 8 candidate. No claim that stock Rokid or Meta officially supports the integration.

candidates.title: Faceclaw prepares iOS TestFlight beta for Even G2 companion interoperability
candidates.summary: October 11 UTC GitHub commits prepare Faceclaw 0.8.3-rc1 TestFlight beta and public signup, add iOS pairing-screen improvements and ANCS notification category icons. These are commits on the project repository, not evidence that the TestFlight build has shipped or that GlassesResearch tested the iOS client. As of discovery, the latest published GitHub release was 0.8.2 (October 4). Hold release-availability claims pending an actual TestFlight distribution or published release.
